Per-operation base URL override in internal/connectors/engine (the bundle's streams.json declares exactly one HTTPBase.URL, {{ config.base_url }}/api/v1/accounts/{{ config.account_id }}; connsdk.Requester.resolveURL always string-concatenates BaseURL+path, and engine.resolveSurfaceEndpointPath explicitly rejects an absolute http(s) path override for rest_read/rest_write operations, so a path outside /api/v1/accounts/{account_id} cannot be addressed without restructuring every existing stream/write path in lockstep)
operations.approval: not implemented: the direct-read executor lacks a reviewed operation-specific request, output-policy, and CLI contract
